headline: CHW @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 3.86 at SEA 4.72, with a projected total of 8.58. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: CHW moved +0.03 runs while SEA moved +0.68, changing the projected margin by -0.64 runs. The projected total climbed +0.71, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Emerson Hancock has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Vargas, Randy Arozarena, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder, Connor Joe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
